h1.es: Limites de Ingresos de Apple Health (Medicaid de Washington, 2026)

subhero.en: Apple Health is Washington state's Medicaid program, covering more than 2 million residents in 2026. Because Washington expanded Medicaid in 2014, Apple Health covers adults ages 19 to 64 up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level regardless of whether they have dependent children. For 2026, a single adult qualifies up to $22,025 per year and a family of four qualifies up to $45,540 per year. Pregnant women and children qualify at a more generous 215% FPL, and Apple Health for Kids with premiums extends children's coverage to 317% FPL.
subhero.es: Apple Health es el programa de Medicaid del estado de Washington, que cubre a mas de 2 millones de residentes en 2026. Dado que Washington expandio Medicaid en 2014, Apple Health cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 anos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza independientemente de si tienen hijos dependientes. Para 2026, un adulto soltero califica hasta $22,025 por ano y una familia de cuatro califica hasta $45,540 por ano. Las mujeres embarazadas y los ninos califican con un limite mas generoso del 215% del FPL, y Apple Health para Ninos con primas extiende la cobertura de los ninos hasta el 317% del FPL.

quickAnswer.en: Apple Health income limits in 2026 are set by the Federal Poverty Level. A single adult qualifies for Apple Health with annual income up to $22,025 (138% FPL); a family of four qualifies up to $45,540. Pregnant women and children qualify at 215% FPL, which equals $34,314 per year for a single person or $70,950 per year for a household of four. Apple Health for Kids with premiums extends coverage for children to 317% FPL. Washington is a Medicaid expansion state, so childless adults qualify for Apple Health at the same 138% FPL threshold as parents and caretakers. Apple Health is administered by the Washington State Health Care Authority (HCA); applications are submitted through Washington Healthplanfinder at wahealthplanfinder.org or by calling 1-855-923-4633.
quickAnswer.es: Los limites de ingresos de Apple Health en 2026 estan establecidos por el Nivel Federal de Pobreza. Un adulto soltero califica para Apple Health con ingresos anuales de hasta $22,025 (138% del FPL); una familia de cuatro califica hasta $45,540. Las mujeres embarazadas y los ninos califican al 215% del FPL, lo que equivale a $34,314 por ano para una persona sola o $70,950 por ano para un hogar de cuatro. Apple Health para Ninos con primas extiende la cobertura hasta el 317% del FPL. Washington es un estado de expansion de Medicaid, por lo que los adultos sin hijos califican para Apple Health con el mismo umbral del 138% del FPL que los padres y cuidadores. Apple Health es administrado por la Autoridad de Atencion Medica del Estado de Washington (HCA); las solicitudes se presentan a traves de Washington Healthplanfinder en wahealthplanfinder.org o llamando al 1-855-923-4633.

introParagraphs.en: Apple Health is Washington state's name for its Medicaid program, operated by the Washington State Health Care Authority (HCA) and covering more than 2 million residents. Washington was among the earliest states to expand Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act, restoring and extending full adult coverage on January 1, 2014. The result is one of the more generous Medicaid programs in the Pacific Northwest: any adult ages 19 to 64 with income at or below 138% of the Federal Poverty Level qualifies for Apple Health with no asset test for MAGI-based categories. The 2026 Federal Poverty Level, anchored at $15,960 for a single person in the 48 contiguous states and $33,000 for a family of four, sets every income threshold on this page. Per the HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines published at aspe.hhs.gov, these figures took effect February 1, 2026.
introParagraphs.es: Apple Health es el nombre que Washington da a su programa de Medicaid, operado por la Autoridad de Atencion Medica del Estado de Washington (HCA) y que cubre a mas de 2 millones de residentes. Washington fue uno de los primeros estados en expandir Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible, restaurando y ampliando la cobertura completa para adultos el 1 de enero de 2014. El resultado es uno de los programas de Medicaid mas generosos del noroeste del Pacifico: cualquier adulto de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza califica para Apple Health sin prueba de activos para las categorias basadas en MAGI. El Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026, anclado en $15,960 para una persona soltera en los 48 estados contiguos y $33,000 para una familia de cuatro, establece todos los umbrales de ingresos en esta pagina.

introParagraphs.en: Apple Health eligibility divides into several main population groups. Adults ages 19 to 64 qualify up to 138% FPL under the standard expansion (no dependent-child requirement). Pregnant individuals qualify up to 215% FPL, with coverage continuing through the end of the month 12 months after the pregnancy ends. Children under age 19 qualify for Apple Health at no cost up to 215% FPL, and Apple Health for Kids with premiums extends coverage to 317% FPL for a modest monthly premium. Seniors age 65 and older, and individuals who qualify for Medicare, are served through Apple Health coverage paired with Medicare Savings Programs (QMB, SLMB, QI-1) and the Aged, Blind, and Disabled (ABD) category with its own income and asset rules. Washington also runs Apple Health for Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) for individuals who need nursing-facility-level care, subject to an asset test and a 60-month lookback for transfers.
introParagraphs.es: La elegibilidad para Apple Health se divide en varios grupos principales de poblacion. Los adultos de 19 a 64 anos califican hasta el 138% del FPL bajo la expansion estandar (sin requisito de hijos dependientes). Las personas embarazadas califican hasta el 215% del FPL, con cobertura continua hasta el final del mes 12 meses despues de que termina el embarazo. Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican para Apple Health sin costo hasta el 215% del FPL, y Apple Health para Ninos con primas extiende la cobertura hasta el 317% del FPL por una prima mensual modesta. Los adultos mayores de 65 anos y las personas que califican para Medicare reciben Apple Health combinado con los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (QMB, SLMB, QI-1) y la categoria de Ancianos, Ciegos y Discapacitados (ABD) con sus propias reglas de ingresos y activos.

introParagraphs.en: Apple Health applications in Washington go through Washington Healthplanfinder at wahealthplanfinder.org, the state's combined health coverage portal run by the Washington Health Benefit Exchange. The same portal handles Apple Health (Medicaid), CHIP (Apple Health for Kids), and ACA marketplace plan enrollment. Applicants can also apply by phone at 1-855-923-4633, by paper through local Community Service Offices operated by the Washington Department of Social and Health Services (DSHS), or through certified application assisters statewide. Washington requires no waiting periods for Apple Health: if you are eligible, coverage generally begins on the date you apply or the first day of the month of application. The household-size table below shows the 2026 Apple Health income limits across adults, children, and pregnant individuals.
introParagraphs.es: Las solicitudes de Apple Health en Washington se realizan a traves de Washington Healthplanfinder en wahealthplanfinder.org, el portal de cobertura de salud combinado del estado administrado por el Washington Health Benefit Exchange. El mismo portal gestiona Apple Health (Medicaid), CHIP (Apple Health para Ninos) e inscripcion en planes del mercado del ACA. Los solicitantes tambien pueden solicitar por telefono al 1-855-923-4633, en papel a traves de las Oficinas de Servicio Comunitario locales operadas por el Departamento de Servicios Sociales y de Salud de Washington (DSHS), o a traves de asistentes de solicitud certificados en todo el estado. Washington no requiere periodos de espera para Apple Health: si es elegible, la cobertura generalmente comienza en la fecha en que solicita o el primer dia del mes de la solicitud.

caption.en: The 2026 Apple Health (Washington Medicaid) income guidelines below are based on the 2026 Federal Poverty Level for the 48 contiguous states. Adult column = Apple Health for Adults (138% FPL, covers adults ages 19 to 64 with or without dependent children). Children column = Apple Health for Kids free tier (215% FPL, no premiums); premium-based Apple Health for Kids extends to 317% FPL. Pregnancy column = Apple Health for Pregnant Individuals (215% FPL, with 12-month postpartum coverage). Add $5,680 of annual income per additional household member beyond 8.
caption.es: Las directrices de ingresos de Apple Health 2026 (Medicaid de Washington) a continuacion se basan en el Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 para los 48 estados contiguos. Columna de adultos = Apple Health para Adultos (138% FPL, cubre adultos de 19 a 64 anos con o sin hijos dependientes). Columna de ninos = Apple Health para Ninos nivel gratuito (215% FPL, sin primas); Apple Health para Ninos con primas se extiende hasta el 317% FPL. Columna de embarazo = Apple Health para Personas Embarazadas (215% FPL, con 12 meses de cobertura postparto). Agregue $5,680 de ingresos anuales por cada miembro adicional del hogar mas alla de 8.

footnote.en: All figures rounded to nearest dollar using 2026 HHS ASPE Poverty Guidelines (aspe.hhs.gov), updated by Washington HCA effective April 1, 2026. Adult threshold uses the standard 138% FPL expansion limit. Apple Health for Kids with premiums covers children at 215-317% FPL: families between 215% and 265% FPL pay $20 per child per month (up to $40 total); families between 265% and 317% FPL pay $30 per child per month (up to $60 total). Apple Health for Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) uses a separate income and asset standard: $2,000 individual asset limit plus a 60-month asset-transfer lookback. Washington eliminated the asset test for Medicare Savings Programs (QMB/SLMB/QI-1) as of 2026.
footnote.es: Todas las cifras redondeadas al dolar mas cercano usando las Pautas de Pobreza HHS ASPE 2026 (aspe.hhs.gov), actualizadas por Washington HCA efectivas el 1 de abril de 2026. El umbral para adultos usa el limite estandar del 138% del FPL para la expansion. Apple Health para Ninos con primas cubre ninos al 215-317% del FPL: familias entre 215% y 265% pagan $20 por nino por mes (hasta $40 total); familias entre 265% y 317% pagan $30 por nino por mes (hasta $60 total). Apple Health para LTSS usa un estandar separado de ingresos y activos: limite de activos de $2,000 para una persona mas un periodo de retrospectiva de 60 meses.

householdSizeTable.source: HHS ASPE 2026 Poverty Guidelines + Washington HCA Income and Resource Standards (HCA 19-0096, April 2026)

intro.en: Apple Health eligibility is based on income, household size, residency, citizenship or immigration status, and program category. Washington uses MAGI-based income rules for most Apple Health categories (adults, children, pregnant individuals, and parents or caretakers), meaning no asset test applies for these groups. Only SSI-linked categories (aged, blind, and disabled adults and long-term services and supports) carry an asset test.
intro.es: La elegibilidad para Apple Health se basa en los ingresos, el tamano del hogar, la residencia, la ciudadania o el estatus migratorio, y la categoria del programa. Washington usa reglas de ingresos basadas en MAGI para la mayoria de las categorias de Apple Health (adultos, ninos, personas embarazadas y padres o cuidadores), lo que significa que no se aplica ninguna prueba de activos para estos grupos. Solo las categorias vinculadas al SSI (adultos ancianos, ciegos y discapacitados y servicios de apoyo a largo plazo) tienen una prueba de activos.

items.en: Washington residency: you must live in Washington state. Washington does not impose a durational residency requirement, so you can apply on the day you move to the state. Homeless individuals may declare a Washington county as their place of residence.
items.es: Residencia en Washington: debe vivir en el estado de Washington. Washington no impone un requisito de residencia de duracion, por lo que puede solicitar el mismo dia que se muda al estado. Las personas sin hogar pueden declarar un condado de Washington como su lugar de residencia.

items.en: Citizenship and immigration status: U.S. citizens qualify immediately. Lawful permanent residents and certain qualified immigrants must wait 5 years before accessing MAGI Medicaid under the federal bar (PRWORA 1996). Washington state uses state-only funds to cover children and pregnant individuals regardless of immigration status. Apple Health Expansion (undocumented adults ages 19 to 64) was available starting July 1, 2024, but new enrollment was capped in December 2025 due to federal funding constraints; existing enrollees retain coverage.
items.es: Ciudadania y estatus migratorio: los ciudadanos estadounidenses califican de inmediato. Los residentes permanentes legales y ciertos inmigrantes calificados deben esperar 5 anos antes de acceder a Medicaid MAGI bajo la barrera federal (PRWORA 1996). El estado de Washington usa fondos estatales para cubrir a ninos y personas embarazadas independientemente del estatus migratorio.

items.en: Age requirements by category: Apple Health for Adults covers ages 19 to 64. Apple Health for Kids covers children under age 19. Pregnant individuals of any age may qualify for Apple Health for Pregnancy. Adults age 65 and older or those enrolled in Medicare are served through the Aged, Blind, and Disabled (ABD) category or Medicare Savings Programs.
items.es: Requisitos de edad por categoria: Apple Health para Adultos cubre edades de 19 a 64. Apple Health para Ninos cubre ninos menores de 19 anos. Las personas embarazadas de cualquier edad pueden calificar para Apple Health para el Embarazo. Los adultos mayores de 65 anos o los inscritos en Medicare reciben servicios a traves de la categoria ABD o los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare.

items.en: Income limit by population: adults ages 19 to 64 qualify up to 138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 per year for a single person). Children under 19 qualify at no cost up to 215% FPL ($34,314 per year for a single-person household), with premium-based coverage to 317% FPL. Pregnant individuals qualify up to 215% FPL ($34,314 per year for a household of one, $70,950 for a household of four). Income is calculated using MAGI rules, which include most taxable income but exclude SSI, child support received, veterans' benefits, and workers' compensation.
items.es: Limite de ingresos por poblacion: los adultos de 19 a 64 anos califican hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026 ($22,025 por ano para una persona sola). Los ninos menores de 19 anos califican sin costo hasta el 215% del FPL ($34,314 por ano para un hogar de una persona), con cobertura con primas hasta el 317% del FPL. Las personas embarazadas califican hasta el 215% del FPL ($34,314 por ano para un hogar de uno, $70,950 para un hogar de cuatro).

items.en: No asset test for MAGI categories: Washington does not impose a savings or asset limit for Apple Health for Adults, Apple Health for Kids, or Apple Health for Pregnancy. You can have a car, home, savings account, or other assets and still qualify, as long as your income falls within the applicable limit.
items.es: Sin prueba de activos para categorias MAGI: Washington no impone un limite de ahorros o activos para Apple Health para Adultos, Apple Health para Ninos, o Apple Health para el Embarazo. Puede tener un automovil, casa, cuenta de ahorros u otros activos y aun calificar, siempre que sus ingresos esten dentro del limite aplicable.

items.en: Other coverage: Apple Health is the payer of last resort. If you have access to employer-sponsored insurance that meets minimum value and affordability standards, Washington may ask you to enroll in that coverage first. However, you cannot be denied Apple Health solely because you have access to other insurance unless it meets specific cost-effectiveness criteria.
items.es: Otra cobertura: Apple Health es el pagador de ultimo recurso. Si tiene acceso a un seguro patrocinado por el empleador que cumple con los estandares minimos de valor y asequibilidad, Washington puede pedirle que se inscriba en esa cobertura primero.

items.en: SSI and long-term care asset rules: adults who qualify for Supplemental Security Income (SSI) automatically qualify for Apple Health. For Apple Health for Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS), including nursing facility care and home and community-based services, an asset limit of $2,000 for an individual applies, along with a 60-month lookback period for asset transfers. Washington uses estate recovery for long-term care Medicaid recipients, generally pursuing assets in the probate estate of deceased recipients who were 55 or older when they received Apple Health LTSS.
items.es: Reglas de activos de SSI y cuidado a largo plazo: los adultos que califican para el Ingreso de Seguridad Suplementario (SSI) califican automaticamente para Apple Health. Para Apple Health para Servicios y Apoyos a Largo Plazo (LTSS), incluida la atencion en instalaciones de enfermeria y los servicios en el hogar y la comunidad, se aplica un limite de activos de $2,000 para una persona, junto con un periodo de revision de 60 meses para las transferencias de activos.

intro.en: Apple Health uses MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) rules to count income for most categories: adults, children, pregnant individuals, and parents and caretakers. MAGI starts with the adjusted gross income on your federal tax return and adds back certain deductions. Washington applies the standard 5% federal disregard for MAGI-based Apple Health categories, which effectively raises the posted 138% FPL threshold to approximately 143% FPL in practice. Only for SSI-linked categories (aged, blind, disabled, and long-term care) does Washington use a different income-counting methodology with an asset test. Sources: Washington Administrative Code (WAC 182-505-0100, WAC 182-509-0001) and Washington HCA Income and Resource Standards (HCA 19-0096, April 2026).
intro.es: Apple Health usa las reglas de MAGI (Ingreso Bruto Ajustado Modificado) para contar los ingresos para la mayoria de las categorias: adultos, ninos, personas embarazadas y padres y cuidadores. MAGI comienza con el ingreso bruto ajustado en su declaracion de impuestos federal y agrega ciertas deducciones. Washington aplica el descuento federal estandar del 5% para las categorias de Apple Health basadas en MAGI, lo que efectivamente eleva el umbral publicado del 138% del FPL a aproximadamente el 143% del FPL en la practica.

included.en: Wages, salaries, and tips (W-2 income): all wages from employment, including tips and bonuses, count in full toward your Apple Health MAGI income.
included.es: Salarios, sueldos y propinas (ingresos W-2): todos los salarios del empleo, incluidas las propinas y los bonos, cuentan en su totalidad para los ingresos MAGI de Apple Health.

included.en: Self-employment net earnings: net profit from self-employment, gig work, or freelance income after deducting allowable business expenses counts toward MAGI. Use Schedule C (or Schedule F for farming) to determine net self-employment income.
included.es: Ganancias netas del trabajo por cuenta propia: la ganancia neta del trabajo por cuenta propia, trabajo temporal o ingresos de freelance despues de deducir los gastos comerciales permitidos cuenta para MAGI.

included.en: Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) benefits: the taxable portion of SSDI counts as MAGI income. Note: Supplemental Security Income (SSI) is excluded (see below).
included.es: Beneficios del Seguro de Incapacidad del Seguro Social (SSDI): la porcion imponible de los beneficios de SSDI cuenta como ingreso MAGI. Nota: el Ingreso de Seguridad Suplementario (SSI) esta excluido.

included.en: Social Security retirement and survivor benefits: the taxable portion of Social Security retirement and survivor benefits counts toward MAGI. Many lower-income households pay little or no tax on Social Security, so in practice the counted amount may be less than the gross benefit.
included.es: Beneficios de jubilacion y supervivencia del Seguro Social: la porcion imponible de los beneficios de jubilacion y supervivencia del Seguro Social cuenta para MAGI.

included.en: Unemployment insurance benefits: Washington State unemployment compensation counts as MAGI income in the year received, whether paid by the Washington Employment Security Department or another state.
included.es: Beneficios del seguro de desempleo: la compensacion por desempleo del estado de Washington cuenta como ingreso MAGI en el ano en que se recibe.

included.en: Pension and retirement distributions: distributions from 401(k), 403(b), IRA, or pension plans count as MAGI income in the year distributed, including the taxable portion of Roth conversions.
included.es: Distribuciones de pension y jubilacion: las distribuciones de planes 401(k), 403(b), IRA o pension cuentan como ingreso MAGI en el ano en que se distribuyen.

included.en: Interest, dividends, and capital gains: taxable interest from savings accounts, dividends from investments, and net capital gains all count toward MAGI income under Medicaid MAGI rules.
included.es: Intereses, dividendos y ganancias de capital: los intereses imponibles de cuentas de ahorro, dividendos de inversiones y ganancias de capital netas cuentan para los ingresos MAGI bajo las reglas de MAGI de Medicaid.

included.en: Rental and royalty income (net): net rental income after allowable deductions (depreciation, mortgage interest, property taxes, maintenance) and net royalty income count toward MAGI.
included.es: Ingresos de alquiler e ingresos por regalias (netos): los ingresos de alquiler netos despues de las deducciones permitidas y los ingresos por regalias netos cuentan para MAGI.

included.en: Alimony received under pre-2019 divorce agreements: alimony payments received under divorce decrees finalized before January 1, 2019, count as MAGI income. Alimony under post-2018 agreements is not counted (TCJA change).
included.es: Pension alimenticia recibida bajo acuerdos de divorcio anteriores a 2019: los pagos de pension alimenticia recibidos bajo decretos de divorcio finalizados antes del 1 de enero de 2019 cuentan como ingreso MAGI.

excluded.en: Supplemental Security Income (SSI): SSI payments from the Social Security Administration are not counted as income for Apple Health MAGI categories. Receiving SSI actually makes you categorically eligible for Apple Health automatically.
excluded.es: Ingreso de Seguridad Suplementario (SSI): los pagos del SSI de la Administracion del Seguro Social no se cuentan como ingresos para las categorias MAGI de Apple Health.

excluded.en: Child support payments received: child support you receive for your children is excluded from MAGI income for Apple Health purposes under federal Medicaid rules.
excluded.es: Pagos de manutencion de hijos recibidos: la manutencion de hijos que recibe para sus hijos esta excluida de los ingresos MAGI para los propositos de Apple Health.

excluded.en: Veterans' benefits: VA disability compensation, pension, dependency and indemnity compensation (DIC), and GI Bill education benefits are all excluded from MAGI income for Apple Health.
excluded.es: Beneficios de veteranos: la compensacion por discapacidad del VA, la pension, la compensacion de dependencia e indemnizacion (DIC) y los beneficios educativos del GI Bill estan excluidos de los ingresos MAGI para Apple Health.

excluded.en: Workers' compensation: payments received from Washington Labor and Industries (L&I) or any workers' compensation program for a work-related injury or illness are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Compensacion de trabajadores: los pagos recibidos de Trabajo e Industrias de Washington (L&I) o cualquier programa de compensacion de trabajadores por una lesion o enfermedad relacionada con el trabajo estan excluidos de los ingresos MAGI.

excluded.en: TANF and WASHCAP cash assistance: Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) grants and Washington's WorkFirst cash grants are excluded from MAGI income for Apple Health purposes.
excluded.es: Asistencia en efectivo TANF y WASHCAP: las subvenciones de Asistencia Temporal para Familias Necesitadas (TANF) y las subvenciones en efectivo WorkFirst de Washington estan excluidas de los ingresos MAGI para Apple Health.

excluded.en: Gifts, inheritances, and one-time lump-sum payments: one-time gifts and inheritances are generally not counted as MAGI income. However, ongoing distributions from an inherited IRA count as income in the year distributed.
excluded.es: Regalos, herencias y pagos unicos en suma global: los regalos y herencias unicos generalmente no se cuentan como ingresos MAGI.

excluded.en: Foster care and kinship care payments: payments received for providing foster care or kinship care to children placed by the state are excluded from MAGI income.
excluded.es: Pagos de acogida familiar y cuidado de parentesco: los pagos recibidos por proporcionar acogida familiar o cuidado de parentesco a ninos colocados por el estado estan excluidos de los ingresos MAGI.

incomeSources.source: Washington Administrative Code WAC 182-509-0001 (MAGI income counting) + Washington HCA Income and Resource Standards HCA 19-0096 (April 2026) + IRS MAGI definition

intro.en: Apple Health applications in Washington go through Washington Healthplanfinder, operated by the Washington Health Benefit Exchange (WAHBE) at wahealthplanfinder.org. The same application captures Apple Health (Medicaid), Apple Health for Kids (CHIP), and ACA marketplace plan enrollment. Applying online takes roughly 15 to 30 minutes. Applicants can also apply by phone at 1-855-923-4633 (available in multiple languages), by paper using Form HCA 18-001, or in person at any DSHS Community Service Office or certified application assister location. Apple Health has no enrollment windows, so applications are accepted year-round.
intro.es: Las solicitudes de Apple Health en Washington se realizan a traves de Washington Healthplanfinder, operado por el Washington Health Benefit Exchange (WAHBE) en wahealthplanfinder.org. La misma solicitud incluye Apple Health (Medicaid), Apple Health para Ninos (CHIP) e inscripcion en planes del mercado del ACA. La solicitud en linea tarda aproximadamente 15 a 30 minutos. Los solicitantes tambien pueden solicitar por telefono al 1-855-923-4633 (disponible en varios idiomas), en papel usando el Formulario HCA 18-001, o en persona en cualquier Oficina de Servicio Comunitario del DSHS.

steps.en: 1. Gather your documents before you start: photo ID, Social Security Numbers for all household members applying for coverage, proof of Washington residency, proof of income for the most recent 30 days (pay stubs, self-employment records, or award letters for benefits), and proof of citizenship or immigration status.
steps.es: 1. Reuna sus documentos antes de comenzar: identificacion con foto, Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura, prueba de residencia en Washington, prueba de ingresos de los ultimos 30 dias, y prueba de ciudadania o estatus migratorio.

steps.en: 2. Create an account at wahealthplanfinder.org or call 1-855-923-4633 to start an application by phone. Washington Healthplanfinder accepts applications in English, Spanish, and multiple other languages through interpreter services.
steps.es: 2. Cree una cuenta en wahealthplanfinder.org o llame al 1-855-923-4633 para comenzar una solicitud por telefono. Washington Healthplanfinder acepta solicitudes en ingles, espanol y varios otros idiomas a traves de servicios de interpretacion.

steps.en: 3. Complete the application by listing every household member, reporting all income sources, and answering eligibility questions for your household. The system will automatically screen for Apple Health, CHIP, and marketplace subsidies based on your answers.
steps.es: 3. Complete la solicitud enumerando a todos los miembros del hogar, informando todas las fuentes de ingresos y respondiendo las preguntas de elegibilidad para su hogar.

steps.en: 4. Submit your application and record your confirmation number. Washington Healthplanfinder will send a confirmation by email or mail. Many Apple Health applicants receive real-time eligibility decisions at the time of application if the system can verify income electronically through federal data sources.
steps.es: 4. Envie su solicitud y registre su numero de confirmacion. Washington Healthplanfinder enviara una confirmacion por correo electronico o correo postal.

steps.en: 5. Respond promptly to any requests for additional information. If the HCA or DSHS cannot verify your income or identity through electronic data sources, you will receive a notice requesting paper documentation. You typically have 10 to 30 days to respond. Failing to respond on time is the most common reason applications are denied.
steps.es: 5. Responda rapidamente a cualquier solicitud de informacion adicional. Si la HCA o el DSHS no puede verificar sus ingresos o identidad a traves de fuentes de datos electronicas, recibira un aviso solicitando documentacion en papel.

steps.en: 6. Wait for your eligibility determination notice. Apple Health applications are generally decided within 45 days; pregnancy applications are decided within 15 days under federal expedited rules. If approved, your Apple Health card or managed care enrollment notice will arrive within a few weeks.
steps.es: 6. Espere el aviso de determinacion de elegibilidad. Las solicitudes de Apple Health generalmente se deciden en un plazo de 45 dias; las solicitudes de embarazo se deciden en 15 dias bajo las reglas federales aceleradas.

documentsNeeded.en: Photo ID for the head of household (Washington driver's license, state ID, passport, or tribal ID card)
documentsNeeded.es: Identificacion con foto para el jefe de familia (licencia de conducir de Washington, identificacion estatal, pasaporte o tarjeta de identificacion tribal)

documentsNeeded.en: Social Security Numbers for every household member applying for Apple Health coverage (or documentation explaining why an SSN is not available)
documentsNeeded.es: Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura de Apple Health (o documentacion que explique por que no se dispone de un SSN)

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of Washington state residency: utility bill, lease or mortgage statement, bank statement, or other official document showing your current address in Washington
documentsNeeded.es: Prueba de residencia en el estado de Washington: factura de servicios publicos, contrato de arrendamiento o hipoteca, estado de cuenta bancaria u otro documento oficial que muestre su direccion actual en Washington

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of U.S. citizenship or qualifying immigration status: birth certificate, U.S. passport, Certificate of Naturalization, Permanent Resident Card (green card), or other immigration documents
documentsNeeded.es: Prueba de ciudadania estadounidense o estatus migratorio calificado: acta de nacimiento, pasaporte de EE.UU., Certificado de Naturalizacion, Tarjeta de Residente Permanente (tarjeta verde) u otros documentos de inmigracion

documentsNeeded.en: Last 30 days of pay stubs, or self-employment records covering the most recent 12 months (for self-employed and gig workers). If you receive Social Security, unemployment, or other benefits, bring your most recent award letter.
documentsNeeded.es: Ultimos 30 dias de talones de pago, o registros de trabajo por cuenta propia que cubran los ultimos 12 meses. Si recibe Seguro Social, desempleo u otros beneficios, traiga su carta de concesion mas reciente.

documentsNeeded.en: For pregnancy applications: a statement from a healthcare provider confirming pregnancy and the expected due date, which enables expedited 15-day processing
documentsNeeded.es: Para solicitudes de embarazo: una declaracion de un proveedor de salud que confirme el embarazo y la fecha de parto esperada, lo que permite el procesamiento acelerado de 15 dias

processingTimeline.en: Standard Apple Health applications are decided within 45 days. Pregnancy applications receive expedited 15-day processing under federal rules. Applications where income and citizenship are verified electronically through federal data sources may receive a real-time determination on the same day. Aged, blind, and disabled (ABD) applications that require a medical disability determination can take 60 to 90 days. Apple Health for Long-Term Services and Supports (LTSS) applications involving nursing-home placement can take up to 90 days.
processingTimeline.es: Las solicitudes estandar de Apple Health se deciden en un plazo de 45 dias. Las solicitudes de embarazo reciben procesamiento acelerado de 15 dias bajo las reglas federales. Las solicitudes donde los ingresos y la ciudadania se verifican electronicamente a traves de fuentes de datos federales pueden recibir una determinacion en tiempo real el mismo dia.

commonDenialReasons.en: Income above the applicable Apple Health threshold: this is the most common reason for denial. Adults are denied if household income exceeds 138% FPL ($22,025 for a single person in 2026). Children with family income above 317% FPL are also ineligible for Apple Health for Kids with premiums.
commonDenialReasons.es: Ingresos por encima del umbral de Apple Health aplicable: esta es la razon mas comun de denegacion. Los adultos son denegados si los ingresos del hogar superan el 138% del FPL ($22,025 para una persona sola en 2026).

commonDenialReasons.en: Failure to provide requested documentation within the response deadline: the Washington HCA or DSHS may request additional documents to verify identity, income, or residency. Failing to respond within 10 to 30 days of the request results in denial for insufficient information.
commonDenialReasons.es: No proporcionar la documentacion solicitada dentro del plazo de respuesta: la HCA o el DSHS de Washington puede solicitar documentos adicionales para verificar la identidad, los ingresos o la residencia.

commonDenialReasons.en: Not a Washington resident: applicants must reside in Washington. Applications are denied when the address provided is in another state or cannot be verified as a Washington address.
commonDenialReasons.es: No ser residente de Washington: los solicitantes deben residir en Washington. Las solicitudes se deniegan cuando la direccion proporcionada esta en otro estado o no se puede verificar como una direccion de Washington.

commonDenialReasons.en: Federal 5-year immigration bar: certain lawful permanent residents and other qualified immigrants who entered the U.S. after August 22, 1996, are subject to a 5-year federal bar on MAGI Medicaid eligibility. This does not apply to children, pregnant individuals, or emergency Medicaid.
commonDenialReasons.es: Barrera federal de 5 anos por inmigracion: ciertos residentes permanentes legales y otros inmigrantes calificados que ingresaron a los EE.UU. despues del 22 de agosto de 1996, estan sujetos a una barrera federal de 5 anos sobre la elegibilidad de Medicaid MAGI.

commonDenialReasons.en: Age or category mismatch: adults age 65 or older who apply for Apple Health for Adults (the MAGI category) are redirected to the Aged, Blind, and Disabled program or Medicare Savings Programs. Applications filed in the wrong category are denied and must be resubmitted under the correct category.
commonDenialReasons.es: Desajuste de edad o categoria: los adultos mayores de 65 anos que solicitan Apple Health para Adultos (la categoria MAGI) son redirigidos al programa de Ancianos, Ciegos y Discapacitados o los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare.

heading.en: If your child's family income is over the free Apple Health for Kids limit
heading.es: Si los ingresos familiares de su hijo superan el limite gratuito de Apple Health para Ninos

body.en: Apple Health for Kids covers children under age 19 for free when family income is at or below 215% of the Federal Poverty Level, which equals $70,950 per year for a family of four in 2026. If family income is between 215% and 317% FPL, children qualify for Apple Health for Kids with premiums: families between 215% and 265% FPL pay $20 per child per month (up to $40 per month total for multiple children), and families between 265% and 317% FPL pay $30 per child per month (up to $60 per month total). The 317% FPL limit equals about $104,610 per year for a family of four in 2026. Apple Health for Kids covers the same full Medicaid benefit package as standard Apple Health, including dental, vision, preventive care, and behavioral health services. Washington's Apple Health for Kids program draws on both federal Medicaid and CHIP funding to deliver this seamless coverage continuum. Compare income limits for children's programs across all 50 states using the national Medicaid income limits guide.
body.es: Apple Health para Ninos cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos de forma gratuita cuando los ingresos familiares son iguales o inferiores al 215% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza, lo que equivale a $70,950 por ano para una familia de cuatro en 2026. Si los ingresos familiares estan entre el 215% y el 317% del FPL, los ninos califican para Apple Health para Ninos con primas: las familias entre el 215% y el 265% del FPL pagan $20 por nino por mes (hasta $40 por mes en total para varios ninos), y las familias entre el 265% y el 317% del FPL pagan $30 por nino por mes (hasta $60 por mes en total).

linkLabel.es: Compare los limites de ingresos de Medicaid y CHIP en los 50 estados

heading.en: If you are 65 or older with limited income: Washington Medicare Savings Programs
heading.es: Si tiene 65 anos o mas con ingresos limitados: Programas de Ahorro de Medicare de Washington

body.en: Washington administers four Medicare Savings Programs (MSPs) through Apple Health for low-income Medicare beneficiaries. As of April 1, 2026, the monthly income limits are: Qualified Medicare Beneficiary (QMB, covers Part A and B premiums, deductibles, and copays) at 110% FPL ($1,483 per month for one person); Specified Low-Income Medicare Beneficiary (SLMB, covers Part B premium only) at 120% FPL ($1,616 per month for one person); Qualifying Individual-1 (QI-1, covers Part B premium only) at 138% FPL ($1,855 per month for one person); and Qualified Disabled and Working Individuals (QDWI, for working individuals with disabilities who lost Medicare) at 200% FPL ($2,680 per month for one person). Washington eliminated the asset test for MSP-only eligibility in 2026, so savings and bank balances no longer affect MSP qualification. Dual-eligible individuals who qualify for both Apple Health and Medicare can access Dual Eligible Special Needs Plans (D-SNPs) through Washington's managed care contractors. To apply for any MSP, use the same Washington Healthplanfinder portal at wahealthplanfinder.org or call the Apple Health Customer Service line at 1-800-562-3022.
body.es: Washington administra cuatro Programas de Ahorro de Medicare (MSP) a traves de Apple Health para beneficiarios de Medicare con ingresos limitados. A partir del 1 de abril de 2026, los limites de ingresos mensuales son: Beneficiario de Medicare Calificado (QMB) al 110% del FPL ($1,483 por mes para una persona); Beneficiario de Medicare de Bajos Ingresos Especificado (SLMB) al 120% del FPL ($1,616 por mes para una persona); Individuo Calificado-1 (QI-1) al 138% del FPL ($1,855 por mes para una persona); y Personas Calificadas con Discapacidad y que Trabajan (QDWI) al 200% del FPL ($2,680 por mes para una persona). Washington elimino la prueba de activos para la elegibilidad solo de MSP en 2026.

linkLabel.es: Lea la guia de elegibilidad de Medicare y los Programas de Ahorro de Medicare

en.question: What is the Apple Health income limit for a family of 4 in 2026?
en.answer: For adults, Apple Health covers a family of four with annual income up to $45,540 (138% of the 2026 Federal Poverty Level). For children, Apple Health for Kids is free for families of four earning up to $70,950 per year (215% FPL), with premium-based coverage extending to $104,610 per year (317% FPL) for a family of four. Pregnant individuals in a household of four qualify up to $70,950 per year (215% FPL). These figures use the 2026 HHS ASPE Poverty Guidelines for the 48 contiguous states.

en.question: Is Washington a Medicaid expansion state?
en.answer: Yes. Washington expanded Medicaid under the Affordable Care Act effective January 1, 2014. Apple Health covers adults ages 19 to 64 up to 138% of the Federal Poverty Level ($22,025 for a single adult in 2026) regardless of whether they have dependent children. Washington was among the first states to utilize ACA expansion, using a CMS waiver from 2011 to 2013 to expand early. As of 2026, roughly 2 million Washingtonians are enrolled in Apple Health.

en.question: What counts as income for Apple Health in 2026?
en.answer: Apple Health uses MAGI (Modified Adjusted Gross Income) rules for most categories. Counted income includes wages and salaries, self-employment net earnings, the taxable portion of Social Security benefits (SSDI and retirement), unemployment compensation, pension and retirement distributions, interest and dividends, capital gains, net rental income, and pre-2019 alimony received. Not counted: SSI payments, child support received, VA disability benefits, workers' compensation, TANF cash assistance, gifts, inheritances, and foster care payments. Washington also applies a 5% federal income disregard on top of the posted thresholds.

en.question: What documents do I need to apply for Apple Health?
en.answer: To apply for Apple Health you will need: (1) photo ID for the head of household, (2) Social Security Numbers for all household members applying for coverage, (3) proof of Washington state residency such as a utility bill or lease, (4) proof of citizenship or qualifying immigration status, (5) last 30 days of pay stubs or self-employment records, and (6) for pregnancy applications, a provider statement confirming pregnancy. You apply through wahealthplanfinder.org or by calling 1-855-923-4633. Many applicants with W-2 income find their income verified electronically without needing to submit documents.

en.question: Can I work and still qualify for Apple Health?
en.answer: Yes. Apple Health for Adults has no work requirement. Washington dropped any prior work-requirement proposals, and the standard ACA expansion covers all adults ages 19 to 64 with income at or below 138% FPL ($22,025 per year for a single person in 2026) regardless of employment status. Working adults count only their net earned income and other MAGI income against the threshold. The 5% disregard means you can earn slightly above the posted threshold and still qualify. If your income rises above 138% FPL, you will likely qualify for ACA marketplace subsidies through Washington Healthplanfinder instead.

en.question: How long does the Apple Health application take?
en.answer: Washington generally decides Apple Health applications within 45 days. Pregnancy applications receive expedited 15-day processing under federal rules. If the Healthplanfinder system can verify your income and identity electronically through federal data sources (for example, from IRS or Social Security records), you may receive a real-time eligibility determination on the same day you apply. Aged, blind, and disabled applications requiring a medical review can take 60 to 90 days. You can check your application status anytime through your Washington Healthplanfinder account.

en.question: What happens if I am denied Apple Health?
en.answer: If Apple Health denies your application, you will receive a written notice explaining the reason. You have 90 days from the date of the denial notice to request a free administrative hearing through the Office of Administrative Hearings (OAH) by calling 800-583-8271 or using the OAH online request form. An administrative law judge (ALJ) will conduct the hearing by phone or in person and issue an initial order. If you disagree with the ALJ's initial order, you can request review by the HCA Board of Appeals. Washington Legal Aid and Northwest Justice Project offer free help with Apple Health appeals for low-income residents.

en.question: Does Apple Health cover dental care?
en.answer: Yes. Apple Health covers comprehensive dental services for most adult enrollees, including exams, X-rays, cleanings, fillings, extractions, and dentures. Washington is one of a minority of states that provides full adult Medicaid dental coverage. Children enrolled in Apple Health for Kids receive dental coverage under the Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnostic and Treatment (EPSDT) benefit, which is broader and more comprehensive than adult dental. Dental services are delivered through Apple Health managed care plans and through DentistLink, the Apple Health dental coordinator.

en.question: What is the difference between Apple Health and Apple Health for Kids (CHIP)?
en.answer: Apple Health is Washington's overall Medicaid program. Apple Health for Adults covers individuals ages 19 to 64 up to 138% FPL. Apple Health for Kids (which incorporates both Medicaid and CHIP funding) covers children under 19 at no cost up to 215% FPL and with small monthly premiums from 215% to 317% FPL. Both provide the same comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, vision, and behavioral health services. The key practical difference is the income threshold: children qualify at a significantly higher income level than adults, and families who earn too much for Apple Health for Adults may still qualify for Apple Health for Kids.

es.question: Cual es el limite de ingresos de Apple Health para una familia de 4 en 2026?
es.answer: Para adultos, Apple Health cubre una familia de cuatro con ingresos anuales de hasta $45,540 (138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza 2026). Para ninos, Apple Health para Ninos es gratuito para familias de cuatro que ganan hasta $70,950 por ano (215% del FPL), con cobertura basada en primas que se extiende hasta $104,610 por ano (317% del FPL) para una familia de cuatro. Las personas embarazadas en un hogar de cuatro califican hasta $70,950 por ano (215% del FPL).

es.question: Es Washington un estado de expansion de Medicaid?
es.answer: Si. Washington expandio Medicaid bajo la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible efectivo el 1 de enero de 2014. Apple Health cubre a adultos de 19 a 64 anos hasta el 138% del Nivel Federal de Pobreza ($22,025 para un adulto soltero en 2026) independientemente de si tienen hijos dependientes. A partir de 2026, aproximadamente 2 millones de residentes de Washington estan inscritos en Apple Health.

es.question: Que cuenta como ingreso para Apple Health en 2026?
es.answer: Apple Health usa las reglas de MAGI para la mayoria de las categorias. Los ingresos contados incluyen salarios y sueldos, ganancias netas del trabajo por cuenta propia, la porcion imponible de los beneficios del Seguro Social, compensacion por desempleo, distribuciones de pension y jubilacion, intereses y dividendos, ganancias de capital, ingresos de alquiler netos y pension alimenticia anterior a 2019 recibida. No se cuentan: pagos del SSI, manutencion de hijos recibida, beneficios de discapacidad del VA, compensacion de trabajadores, asistencia en efectivo TANF, regalos, herencias y pagos de acogida familiar.

es.question: Que documentos necesito para solicitar Apple Health?
es.answer: Para solicitar Apple Health necesitara: (1) identificacion con foto para el jefe de familia, (2) Numeros de Seguro Social para todos los miembros del hogar que solicitan cobertura, (3) prueba de residencia en el estado de Washington, (4) prueba de ciudadania o estatus migratorio calificado, (5) ultimos 30 dias de talones de pago o registros de trabajo por cuenta propia, y (6) para solicitudes de embarazo, una declaracion del proveedor que confirme el embarazo. Puede solicitar en wahealthplanfinder.org o llamando al 1-855-923-4633.

es.question: Puedo trabajar y aun calificar para Apple Health?
es.answer: Si. Apple Health para Adultos no tiene requisito de trabajo. Washington cubre a todos los adultos de 19 a 64 anos con ingresos iguales o inferiores al 138% del FPL ($22,025 por ano para una persona sola en 2026) independientemente del estado de empleo. Los adultos trabajadores solo cuentan sus ingresos netos del trabajo y otros ingresos MAGI contra el umbral. El descuento del 5% significa que puede ganar un poco por encima del umbral publicado y aun calificar.

es.question: Cuanto tiempo toma la solicitud de Apple Health?
es.answer: Washington generalmente decide las solicitudes de Apple Health en un plazo de 45 dias. Las solicitudes de embarazo reciben procesamiento acelerado de 15 dias bajo las reglas federales. Si el sistema de Healthplanfinder puede verificar sus ingresos e identidad electronicamente, puede recibir una determinacion de elegibilidad en tiempo real el mismo dia en que solicita. Puede verificar el estado de su solicitud en cualquier momento a traves de su cuenta de Washington Healthplanfinder.

es.question: Que sucede si me niegan Apple Health?
es.answer: Si Apple Health niega su solicitud, recibira un aviso por escrito que explica la razon. Tiene 90 dias desde la fecha del aviso de denegacion para solicitar una audiencia administrativa gratuita a traves de la Oficina de Audiencias Administrativas (OAH) llamando al 800-583-8271. Un juez de derecho administrativo (ALJ) realizara la audiencia por telefono o en persona. Northwest Justice Project ofrece ayuda gratuita con las apelaciones de Apple Health para residentes de bajos ingresos.

es.question: Apple Health cubre la atencion dental?
es.answer: Si. Apple Health cubre servicios dentales integrales para la mayoria de los adultos inscritos, incluyendo examenes, radiografias, limpiezas, empastes, extracciones y dentaduras. Washington es uno de los pocos estados que proporciona cobertura dental completa de Medicaid para adultos. Los ninos inscritos en Apple Health para Ninos reciben cobertura dental bajo el beneficio EPSDT, que es mas amplio que el dental para adultos.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre Apple Health y Apple Health para Ninos (CHIP)?
es.answer: Apple Health es el programa general de Medicaid de Washington. Apple Health para Adultos cubre a personas de 19 a 64 anos hasta el 138% del FPL. Apple Health para Ninos (que incorpora fondos de Medicaid y CHIP) cubre a ninos menores de 19 anos sin costo hasta el 215% del FPL y con pequenas primas mensuales del 215% al 317% del FPL. Ambos brindan el mismo paquete integral de beneficios. La diferencia practica clave es el umbral de ingresos: los ninos califican con un nivel de ingresos significativamente mas alto que los adultos.
